name: clawdcursor
stderr:
Usage: clawdcursor [options] [command]

🐾 AI Desktop Agent — native screen control

Options:
  -V, --version      output the version number
  -h, --help         display help for command

Commands:
  agent [options]    Start the clawdcursor daemon (MCP over HTTP; your own agent
                     drives the tools)
  start [options]    [deprecated — use `clawdcursor agent`] Start the Clawd
                     Cursor agent
  doctor             🩺 Diagnose setup: version, consent, screen capture,
                     accessibility, permissions. Driving clawdcursor over MCP
                     needs no doctor: consent + (macOS) `grant` is the whole
                     setup.
  status             📊 Check readiness status (consent, permissions)
  versions           📦 List every copy of clawdcursor on this machine (global
                     install, Claude Desktop extension, Claude Code plugin) and
                     flag old ones
  grant              🔐 Request macOS permissions (triggers system permission
                     dialogs)
  stop [options]     Stop every running Clawd Cursor instance; agents stay
                     stopped until `clawdcursor resume`
  resume [options]   Continue a task paused for you (same as the on-screen
                     Resume), or --end it. After a stop, gives control back.
  uninstall          Remove all Clawd Cursor config, data, and skill
                     registrations
  mcp [options]      Run as MCP tool server over stdio (for Claude Code, Cursor,
                     Windsurf, Zed)
  serve [options]    [deprecated — use `clawdcursor agent`] Start the tool
                     server only
  report [options]   Report the last session (or agent task) to the clawdcursor
                     team. Shows a preview first; no typed text, clipboard or
                     screenshots.
  consent [options]  Manage desktop control consent (required before MCP/REST
                     use)
  register-skill     (Re)register clawdcursor as a skill in your AI agents
                     (Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Cursor)
  help [command]     display help for command
